Independent tutorial expectations for ALAS1 and PRDX1.
Generated from the unchanged assemble_region_m6a and pileup_reads functions
in parsing_footprints_functions.r; source SHA256 is in SHARED_SOURCES.json.
Matrices are reads x positions (the tutorial orientation); native assays
transpose this to positions x reads. Profiles include every full-span read
in the denominator, including zero-call reads.
Regeneration: Rscript inst/scripts/generate_oracle.R PACKAGE_ROOT ORIGINAL_PARSING_SOURCE
